brief:
General Investigation police in Khan Younis arrested a man suspected of firing a Kalashnikov rifle into the air during a family dispute, Shehab Wire reported. The suspect was detained by officers from the Eastern Division of the Khan Younis police department after authorities received a report of gunfire at the scene.

Police did not disclose the identity of the suspect or provide details about those involved in the dispute. The circumstances that prompted the suspect to discharge the weapon during the family conflict remain under investigation by the General Investigation directorate.
